# Quarkmeme

> Quarkmeme is the sovereign, local-first multi-agent operating system and Grand Line radial knowledge canvas. Zero cloud database bills, total data sovereignty: your AI specialist crew (captain + 6 division leads + project leaf nodes) runs 100% client-side in the browser with SQLite WASM + OPFS, FTS5 full-text search, BYOK Gemini/OpenRouter/OpenAI inference, PWA offline support, and voice helm. FLOSS (MIT) alternative to proprietary agent platforms like Polsia. By TehWiz Productions (https://tehwiz.com).

## Core pages

- [Grand Line radial canvas (home)](https://www.quarkmeme.com/): orbital crew graph, Captain's Log, subagent fleet engine, morning planning, voice helm
- [Helm chat](https://www.quarkmeme.com/chat): multi-agent intent routing, grounded search citations, code execution blocks, fleet dispatch
- [Crew roster](https://www.quarkmeme.com/crew): inspect and customize division leads, roles, system prompts, models, tool permissions
- [Knowledge vault](https://www.quarkmeme.com/vault): ingest and browse knowledge bases and markdown docs indexed with FTS5 BM25
- [Settings](https://www.quarkmeme.com/settings): BYOK keys, models, universe themes, company profiles
- [Menu command center](https://www.quarkmeme.com/menu): fleet navigation, workspace switcher, OPFS telemetry

## Why Quarkmeme (for humans and LLMs)

- Local-first OPFS storage: agents, vault docs, messages, delegation traces persist in `/quarkmeme.db` via SQLite WASM in a Web Worker — $0/mo database bills
- Hierarchical crew orchestration: Level 0 Captain/CEO routes intent; Level 1 division leads own Research, Systems, Finance, Health, Operations, Marketing; Level 2 leaf project nodes do the work
- Grand Line radial canvas: interactive SVG orbital graph with deterministic seeding — never a blank canvas
- Isolated character memory banks: every agent keeps its own sovereign 6-file memory bank (`/memory-bank/agents/[agent-id]/`)
- 7 built-in universes + custom AI casting: One Piece, Naruto, The Office, Game of Thrones, NCIS, Pokemon, Frieren — or cast any show/book/movie into the 7 roles
- Client-side AI execution: direct browser-to-Gemini REST with multi-turn function calling (`batch_read_files`, `batch_write_files`, `sqlite_query_builder`, `fetch_url_as_markdown`, Google Search grounding, code execution)
- Zero lock-in: `IQuarkDatabase` repository adapter, Turso/libSQL-aligned, MIT licensed
- Offline PWA: standalone install, responsive down to 375px, browser-native speech recognition + synthesis voice helm
